title: `PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D` shape has `radius=0` when physics runs on separate thread
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot v4.6.2.stable

### Issue description

When **Project Settings → Physics → 3D → Run on Separate Thread** is enabled, constructing a `PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D` with a `SphereShape3D`, `CapsuleShape3D`, or `CylinderShape3D` causes the shape to be built with `radius=0` (and `height=0` for capsule and cylinder) despite setting non-zero values, making the query fail.

With Jolt Physics, two errors are thrown and the query returns no result. With GodotPhysics3D, the query silently returns no result with no error.

The same code works correctly when physics runs on the main thread.

Two errors are thrown with Jolt Physics (using `SphereShape3D`):

```
E 0:00:00:785   node_3d.gd:12 @ _physics_process(): Failed to build Jolt Physics sphere shape with {radius=0.000000}. Its radius must be greater than 0. This shape belongs to '<unknown>' and 0 other object(s).
  <C++ Error>   Condition "radius <= 0.0f" is true. Returning: nullptr
  <C++ Source>  modules/jolt_physics/shapes/jolt_sphere_shape_3d.cpp:38 @ _build()
  <Stack Trace> node_3d.gd:12 @ _physics_process()
```

```
E 0:00:00:785   node_3d.gd:12 @ _physics_process(): Parameter "jolt_shape" is null.
  <C++ Source>  modules/jolt_physics/spaces/jolt_physics_direct_space_state_3d.cpp:737 @ rest_info()
  <Stack Trace> node_3d.gd:12 @ _physics_process()
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable **Project Settings → Physics → 3D → Run on Separate Thread**
2. Attach the following script to any `Node3D`:
```gdscript
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    var world := get_world_3d()

    var params := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D.new()
    params.shape = SphereShape3D.new()
    params.shape.radius = 1.0
    params.transform = Transform3D()

    var result := world.direct_space_state.get_rest_info(params)
    print(result)
```
3. Run the scene
